 The Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) has declared the timetable for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027 on the board's website, cgbse.nic.in
 CG Board Exam Date 2027 (OUT) Live Updates; Download Class 10th, 12th CG Board Time Table PDF
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 19 2026 | 12:41 PM IST Listen to This Article
 The Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) has declared the CG Board exam date 2027 for 10th and 12th Class students. As per the CGBSE 12th exam datesheet 2027, Class 12th exams will be conducted from March 12 to April 8, 2027.    On the other hand, class 10th exams will run from March 13 to April 5, 2027. All exams will run on a single shift, from 9:15 AM to 12:15 PM. Students can check their subject-wise exam dates and other important notifications on the board’s official website, cgbse.nic.in??.     How to check the CGBSE board exam class 10, 12 datesheet 2027?

   The Chhattisgarh Board examinations will be held from 9:15 AM to 12:15 PM. As per the reported examination guidelines:   Students should be seated at their examination centres by 8 AM.   Answer sheets will be distributed sharp at 9:05 AM.   Question papers will be distributed sharp at 9:10 AM.   Answer writing will start at 9:15 AM and will end at 12:15 PM.   Chhattisgarh Board Exam 2027 Practical Examination   CGBSE has provided guidelines concerning the practical and project exams for private (Swadhyayi) students. These exams will be held at their assigned examination centers and could also occur during holidays if necessary.    Students must stay in communication with the superintendents of their respective examination centers to obtain details regarding the schedules for practical examinations.   ALSO READ:  UPSC CSE 2026 interview dates announced, personality tests from December 7   More From This Section
